name: Gauntlet
notes: Gauntlet is a risk-modeling firm / vault curator (operates curated Morpho & Aave vaults), not a protocol with its own contracts to index. TVL is the sum of vaults it curates on Morpho/Aave/etc. No Gauntlet-specific public subgraph/indexer; the underlying data lives in Morpho/Aave subgraphs. One confirming search; marked false.

name: Uniswap V3

repos.scope: Full Uniswap V3 protocol: factory, pools, swaps, mints, burns, positions, ticks across all supported chains (multi-chain template).
repos.verified: WebFetch of repo: contains v3-subgraph.template.yaml + schema, TypeScript mappings (99.4%), 413 commits, 26 PRs, 91 open issues; indexes factory/pool/swap events. Official Uniswap Labs org.

notes: Official Uniswap Labs subgraph. Many community forks exist (revert-finance, opynfinance, messari) but official repo is canonical.

name: Curve DEX

repos.scope: Curve pools volume/revenue/OHLC across 10 chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, etc.). Does NOT track liquidity events.
repos.verified: WebFetch: official curvefi org repo, 322 commits, subgraph configs for 10 chains, tracks pool volume snapshots + APR + OHLC via Curve address provider contract.
Listed under official curvefi org in search; companion to volume-subgraphs.

notes: Official curvefi org maintains subgraphs. volume-subgraphs is the actively used one. Community alternatives: protofire/curve-subgraph, messari/subgraphs curve-finance.

name: HashKey Exchange
notes: Centralized exchange (custodial). TVL is wallet balances tracked by DefiLlama; no on-chain protocol contracts to index. CEX entries do not have public subgraphs/indexers. Marked false.

name: Falcon Finance
notes: USDf synthetic-dollar / basis-trading protocol. No public Falcon Finance org or subgraph/indexer repo found; collateral is largely off-chain/custodial (basis trading). Marked false.

name: USDD
notes: TRON DAO Reserve algorithmic stablecoin, primarily on Tron (TRC-20). The Graph does not support Tron; no public USDD subgraph/indexer repo found. Marked false.

name: CCIP
notes: Chainlink CCIP cross-chain messaging. Core protocol is open source (smartcontractkit/chainlink-ccip, smartcontractkit/ccip) but these are protocol/offchain node code, not a subgraph/indexer of CCIP TVL. Status tracking is via the hosted CCIP Explorer (closed). No public subgraph indexing CCIP lane/token-pool TVL found. Marked false.

name: Poloniex
notes: Centralized exchange (custodial). No on-chain protocol contracts; CEX entries have no public subgraph/indexer. Marked false.

name: Bitkub
notes: Centralized exchange (custodial, Thailand). No public protocol subgraph/indexer. Marked false.

name: Pendle

repos.scope: Pendle yield contracts: all forges (Aave/Compound), yield tokens (xyt/ot), markets/pairs, locked/minted/redeemed volume.
repos.verified: WebFetch: official pendle-finance org subgraph, 86 commits, indexes yield contracts + tokens + pairs. ARCHIVED by owner on Jan 9 2026 (read-only).

notes: Official Pendle subgraph-v3 is now ARCHIVED (Jan 2026). Pendle also publishes @pendle/subgraph-sdk on npm. Current Pendle data is largely served via their hosted API; archived subgraph is the public indexer of record.

name: Spiko

repos.scope: Morpho Blue lending subgraph (Messari schema) maintained by Spiko; tracks Morpho markets relevant to Spiko collateral. Fork of morpho-org/morpho-blue-subgraph.
repos.verified: WebFetch of spiko-tech org: only subgraph repo present is morpho-blue-subgraph (a Morpho fork), not a dedicated Spiko securities subgraph.

notes: Spiko (spiko-tech) maintains contracts repos (EVM, Starknet, Stellar, Solana) and a deployed 'spiko-base'/'spiko-*' subgraph appears on The Graph Explorer (Arbitrum/Base) indexing Spiko fund tokens (EUTBL/USTBL) - but the dedicated securities-subgraph source is NOT in a public repo; only the morpho-blue-subgraph fork is public. Marked true on the strength of the deployed Graph subgraph + public Morpho fork; source of the tokenized-fund subgraph itself is not public/located.

name: Kamino Lend
notes: Solana lending protocol (Kamino-Finance/klend is the open-source program, but that is contracts not an indexer). The Graph/Ponder/Subsquid do not index Solana; no public Kamino subgraph/indexer. Third-party position monitors exist (csacanam/kamino-positions-monitor) but are not protocol indexers. Marked false.

name: Ondo Global Markets
notes: Ondo tokenized global-markets (equities) product. ondoprotocol publishes token contract repos (e.g. usdy) but no public subgraph/indexer found for Ondo Global Markets. Marked false.

name: Compound V3

repos.scope: Compound III (Comet) markets: supply/borrow, collateral, rates, liquidations across Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Scroll (+ testnets).
repos.verified: WebFetch: contains subgraph.yaml + schema.graphql + TS mappings for Comet contracts, multi-chain configs; 42 commits, no recent activity timestamps shown.

notes: No official compound-finance subgraph for V3 (only compound-finance/comet contracts and the older compound-finance/compound-v2-subgraph). papercliplabs/compound-v3-subgraph is the established community Comet subgraph. Recorded as the public indexer of record.

name: Venus Core Pool

repos.scope: Officially maintained monorepo of Venus subgraphs incl. core-pool/markets, isolated pools, governance on BNB Chain (and other Venus chains).
repos.verified: WebFetch: official VenusProtocol org monorepo, 1024 commits, matchstick tests + CI, deploys 'Markets' subgraph to BSC. Core Pool subgraph moved here from the now-archived venus-subgraph repo.

notes: Official VenusProtocol/subgraphs monorepo. The standalone VenusProtocol/venus-subgraph is archived (migrated into the monorepo). Also VenusProtocol/venus-governance-subgraph.

name: Veda
notes: Veda Labs (BoringVault). Public repos are contracts/UI only (boring-vault, boring-vault-svm, boring-vault-plasma, boring-vault-ui) plus DefiLlama adapters. No subgraph/ponder/subquery/indexer repo found in the Veda-Labs org. Marked false.

name: Bitmex
notes: Centralized derivatives exchange (custodial). No on-chain protocol contracts to index; no public subgraph/indexer. Marked false.

name: Sanctum Validator LSTs
notes: Solana liquid-staking (validator LSTs via Sanctum). Solana programs are not indexable by The Graph/Ponder/Subsquid; no public Sanctum subgraph/indexer repo found. Marked false.

name: Kelp
notes: Kelp DAO (rsETH liquid restaking, EVM). Kelp-DAO org publishes contracts (LRT-rsETH), eigenpod-proofs-generation, DefiLlama/dimension adapters, but no dedicated subgraph/indexer repo found. Marked false (no official or clear community protocol subgraph located).

name: Blockchain Capital
notes: Tokenized fund (BCAP) on zkSync Era. Only a token smart-contract repo exists (BCAPtoken/BCAPToken); no subgraph/indexer found. Marked false.

name: Bitstamp
notes: Centralized exchange (custodial). No on-chain protocol contracts; no public subgraph/indexer. Marked false.

name: Ethena USDtb
notes: Ethena USDtb (BlackRock BUIDL-backed stablecoin, Ethereum). ethena-labs publishes usdtb-minting-client (SDK/UI) only; no subgraph/indexer repo found for USDtb. Marked false.

name: Kinetiq kHYPE
notes: Liquid staking for HYPE on Hyperliquid L1. Only audit/contract repo found (code-423n4/2025-04-kinetiq); no public Kinetiq subgraph/indexer. HyperEVM subgraph support is nascent. Marked false.

name: Rocket Pool

repos.scope: Rocket Pool protocol: rETH balances/mint/burn/transfers, minipools, nodes, RPL, Redstone/Atlas upgrades.
repos.verified: Listed under official rocket-pool org; last updated Aug 22 2023 per repo listing. Community contribution (Data Nexus & VGR) hosted in the official org with plan to transfer ownership.

repos.scope: Rocket Pool mainnet subgraph v2.0.0 incl. Redstone+Atlas contracts (rETH, minipools, nodes, RPL).
repos.verified: WebFetch: contains subgraph.yaml + schema.graphql + TS mappings; 46 commits; states 'community contribution by Data Nexus & VGR with aim to transfer ownership to Rocket Pool dev team'.

notes: Official rocket-pool org hosts rocket-pool-subgraph (community-built by Data Nexus & VGR; stale, last update 2023). Data-Nexus/rocket-pool-mainnet is the maintainer's source repo. Docs at docs.rocketpool.net document the subgraph entities.

name: Jupiter Lend
notes: Solana lending (Jupiter). Open-source programs exist (audit repo code-423n4/2026-02-jupiter-lend; jup-ag/cli) but these are Solana programs/CLI, not a subgraph/indexer. The Graph/Ponder/Subsquid do not index Solana. Marked false.
